summary_md: **Ella ([@ellatracker](https://x.com/ellatracker/status/2116318999009173675))** cites *Design Creativity Bench* ([arXiv 2610.11539](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.11539v1)). Frontier models score well on appropriateness but poorly on originality and creative range for UI design, which matches what designers in her own study saw.
